statements.status_notes: Upstream ONNX 1.21.0 save_external_data TOCTOU hardening backported in package/deb/main/onnx/patch/CVE-2026-49114.patch (path validation and O_NOFOLLOW atomic open in onnx/external_data_helper.py).

Same save_external_data TOCTOU hardening as CVE-2026-49114 in package/deb/main/onnx/patch/CVE-2026-49114.patch.
ExternalDataInfo attribute whitelist and file-size bounds validation backported in package/deb/main/onnx/patch/CVE-2026-34445.patch.
onnx.hub.load no longer bypasses repo trust checks when silent=True; untrusted repos are rejected in package/deb/main/onnx/patch/CVE-2026-28500.patch (upstream removed hub in ONNX 1.21.0).

Upstream ONNX 1.21.0 external data symlink containment backported in package/deb/main/onnx/patch/CVE-2026-27489.patch (checker.cc canonical path checks) and onnx/external_data_helper.py O_NOFOLLOW open in package/deb/main/onnx/patch/CVE-2026-34445.patch.
Debian onnx 1.17.0-3 ships upstream 1.17.0, which includes the ONNX 1.16.2 fix for download_model_with_test_data tar path traversal (Debian #1075852).
save_external_data path traversal is mitigated by ONNX 1.21.0 external data hardening backported in package/deb/main/onnx/patch/CVE-2026-49114.patch and CVE-2026-27489.patch.
